newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: AMP/Ergo cut NZ floating mortgage rate to 8.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: AMP/Ergo cut NZ floating mortgage rate to 8.95 pct.

text.p: Financial institution AMP and its New Zealand telephone banking arm Ergo said on Thursday they had dropped their floating mortgage rate to 8.95 percent from 9.4 percent, effective immediately for new business and from May 19 for existing business.
They said they were also offering a special six month fixed rate of 8.6 percent, effective immediately, for a limited time.
Ergo's one, two and three year fixed rates are 9.25 percent, 9.6 percent and 9.75 percent respectively.
AMP is the Austrialian Mutual Provident Society.
